correctness.rationale: The shift sends different basis vectors to orthogonal vectors, so the coordinate singular weights are u_k√[(α_j+1)/(k+1)]. The outgoing minus incoming squared sum is ((k+d)/(k+1))u_k²−u_(k−1)², with no incoming term at 0; multiplying by D_k gives exactly b_k−b_(k−1). Positivity and the trace identity follow by telescoping. The mean of the factor (α_j+1)/(k+1) is at least 1/d, so uniformly in degree a positive fraction exceeds 1/(2d), giving the p-summability test for every p>0. A nonzero monotone b_k is eventually bounded below, forcing divergence at and below q_d. If b_k is bounded, the degree cutoff yields O(t^(−q_d)) weights above t. If it diverges, the degrees from K/2 to K contribute order K^d weights of size at least a constant times √b_floor(K/2) K^(-(d−1)/2), violating the weak bound (noncompact coordinates already fail it). For finite positive b, scale the multiindices by L=[b(d−1)!/t²]^(1/(d−1)). Outside a bounded radial simplex there are no weights above t, and a neighborhood h<ε of the origin contributes O(ε^d L^d) lattice points. Away from it the limiting indicator is x_j>h^d with h=Σx_i; its boundary has measure zero. The volume is E[V^(d/(d−1))]/d! with V~Beta(1,d−1). Multiplying by t^q_d L^d recovers the claimed C_(d,b), including the d=2 and d=3 constants. Monotone inversion and harmonic summation give the residue. The zero tuple obeys the equivalence but is excluded from the positive constant law as stipulated.
residual_risks: The estimate on a full block of grades uses monotonicity; without it the arbitrary-profile strong-ideal criterion, not the asserted weak equivalence, is established. Finite rational checks do not prove the Weyl limit.

value.rationale: This radial model provides a natural test for what sum-hyponormality controls. Its endpoint classifies a coordinate weak ideal by an invariant of the tuple, and sharply separates finite and infinite positive defect trace even when all coordinates are compact. Recovering the entire leading singular-value scale and log residue from the total trace, independent of the defect's grade distribution, is quantitative information beyond the known existence example or strong-ideal obstruction.
residual_risks: No transfer beyond the radial family and no second-order law is credited.
